metrics.instructions: The prompt asks which framework controls one piece of evidence supports. The reference response is the accepted answer: a JSON array of control ids. The generated response is the answer to grade. Rate 1 when both arrays hold exactly the same ids, in any order. Rate 0 when an id is missing, an id is added, or the answer is not a JSON array. An added id claims support that does not exist: it is an error, not a detail.

scaleDefinitions.definition: The generated set of control ids is exactly the reference set.
The generated set differs from the reference set, or cannot be parsed.

metrics.instructions: A generated answer may carry a passage quoted from the evidence. Rate 1 when every quoted passage appears in the evidence text given in the prompt. Rate 0 when a quoted passage cannot be found there, or when the answer claims support without quoting anything. Ignore letter case and punctuation when comparing.

scaleDefinitions.definition: Every quoted passage appears in the evidence text.
A quoted passage is absent from the evidence text, or no quote backs the claim.
